raw.markdown:
# PGT-A / PGT-M / PGT-SR — Authorization Guide

_CPT Codes · ICD-10 · Payer Requirements_

Back link: /pgt

## CPT Codes

| CPT | Description | Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 89290 | Biopsy, oocyte polar body or embryo blastomere, microtechnique (for PGT); ≤5 embryos | Biopsy ≤5 |
| 89291 | Biopsy, oocyte polar body or embryo blastomere, microtechnique; >5 embryos | Biopsy >5 |
| 88271 | Molecular cytogenetics; DNA probe, each (FISH) | FISH analysis |
| 88272 | Molecular cytogenetics; chromosomal in situ hybridization, analyze 5 cells | FISH 5 cells |
| 88273 | Molecular cytogenetics; chromosomal in situ hybridization, analyze 10 cells | FISH 10 cells |
| 88374 | Morphometric analysis, in situ hybridization (quantitative or semi-quantitative) | Morphometric |
| 81228 | Cytogenomic constitutional (genome-wide) microarray analysis | Array CGH/SNP |
| 81229 | Cytogenomic constitutional microarray analysis; interrogation of genomic regions | Comprehensive array |

## ICD-10 Diagnoses

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| N96 | Recurrent pregnancy loss |
| O09.291 | Supervision of pregnancy with other poor reproductive or obstetric history |
| Z84.81 | Family history of carrier of genetic disease |
| Z13.88 | Encounter for screening for disorder due to exposure to contaminants |
| Z31.430 | Encounter of female for testing for genetic disease carrier status for procreative management |
| Z31.438 | Encounter for other genetic testing of female for procreative management |
| Q95.0 | Balanced autosomal translocation in normal individual |
| Q95.2 | Balanced autosomal inversion in normal individual |
| Z31.83 | Encounter for assisted reproductive fertility procedure cycle |

## Coverage Landscape

### Common Denial Reasons

- "Screening" — not covered under diagnostic benefit
- "Experimental" for PGT-A (incorrect — well-established since 1990s)
- Bundled with IVF — denied as "part of IVF cycle"
- No covered genetic disorder indication (for PGT-M)

### Strongest Coverage Arguments

- PGT-M for known genetic disorder: diagnostic, not screening — prevents birth of child with serious disease
- PGT-SR for translocation: prevents recurrent pregnancy loss from unbalanced translocations
- RPL indication: PGT-A identifies aneuploid embryos causing recurrent losses
- CPT 89290/89291 (biopsy) are distinct from IVF CPT codes — not bundled

## Prior Authorization Requirements

### Required Documentation

- Specific PGT indication documented (RPL, known genetic disorder, translocation, repeated IVF failure)
- For PGT-M: genetic counseling report, molecular diagnosis of specific disorder
- For PGT-SR: karyotype report confirming translocation
- For RPL: documentation of 2+ pregnancy losses with pathology/karyotype if available
- Letter of medical necessity from REI specialist and/or genetic counselor
- IVF authorization (PGT requires concurrent IVF cycle)
